Re-inventory at main 604080fc by claude-sm-0923. Read-only; ticket not claimed. The lead sequenced it after the current integration batch (Fray #66 seq626).

Already sealed (final non-case, probed outside align): CostWeights, CellSupportBasis, SupportAssessment.{Assessed,Unestablished,NotApplicable}, Structural{MemberEstimate,MemberExclusion,ReductionReceipt,Reduction}, CostBreakdown (AlignWire.costBreakdown).

Remaining holes:
(1) Admissibility (cost.scala:1034) is still 'final case class private[align]'.
 - Doors: companion fromProduct and summon[Mirror.ProductOf] are public from any package; copy/apply/new work anywhere inside align.
 - Fails the cartesian test: faithful must equal contradictions.isEmpty, and distortion must equal the contradictions' facets.
 - No probe covers the fromProduct/Mirror doors; LawsSuite.scala:136-145 checks only new/apply.
 - Mitigation today: HsmmResult.validated re-derives it via AdmissibilityEcho/GateDrift (hsmm.scala:509-524). The direct readers, embed-bench metrics.scala:151 and evidence.scala:165, are not covered by that.
(2) StructuralCoverage (source.scala:24) is a public case class with a relational invariant (membersWithEvidence <= members, non-negative) and no factory. It is re-checked only when it arrives inside a CostBreakdown (AlignWire.coverageOk, wire.scala:244).

Not holes: FunctionPrior and DefaultLocalCostModel have no cross-field relation, and FunctionPrior is a probe's positive control. FidelityMode.Distorted and AlignState.Distorted accept every non-empty facet set.

Plan:
- Convert Admissibility and StructuralCoverage to final non-case classes with checked factories.
- Add an outside-package probe (storymodel4s.probes) for new/apply/copy/fromProduct/Mirror, with same-shape positive controls.
- Mutation-kill each refusal.
- No overlap with solo/tie-policy, which touches candidates and evidence only.
